Marissa/Alice/Steph —

Quick update and what we can provide today: 

1) Pen test report: We can share a redacted copy of the full penetration test report from the third-party engagement conducted 2026-11-30. I'll attach the redacted PDF (redactions are limited to customer-identifying data and PoC details). Executive summary is included in the attached PDF.

2) SOC 2: Our latest SOC 2 Type II attestation (period covered: Jun 2025 - May 2026) is available and attached. The scope covers our inference API, authentication, and logging subsystems.

3) Scanning cadence & vuln management:
- Internal static analysis (SAST): weekly on main branches and on PRs.
- Dynamic scanning (DAST): monthly against staging environments.
- Dependency/OSS scanning: continuous via our CI pipeline with weekly reporting.
- External penetration testing: annual by an accredited third party; last engagement 2026-11-30.

4) SLA / remediation targets (typical):
- Critical/P0 (remote code exec, clear data exfil): 7 days to mitigation + 30 days to full remediation plan completion.
- High/P1 (auth bypass, clear data exposure): 30 days to mitigation plan, 90 days to remediation depending on complexity.
- Medium/P2: 90 days to remediation, tracked in backlog.
- Low/P3: prioritized by product cycles.

5) Disclosure & coordination: We operate a coordinated disclosure policy — we will authenticate the reporter, provide acknowledgement within 48 hours, and provide a remediation timeline. We redact PoCs in shared reports but can arrange an NDA/TD if they need full technical PoCs.

Attachments included: redwood_pen_test_report_20261130.pdf (redacted), SOC2_TypeII_attestation_202605.pdf

If FinHealth needs signed attestations or additional evidence (config screenshots, control narratives), we can provide those via an SSO-protected shared drive link or by sending over a secured transfer.

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to go through the exec summary.

Regards,
